friendly_name: Gherkin test trim, scenario-results follow-ups and a translatable Overview label
purpose_context: The Gherkin and scenario-results features grew fast across 0.3.0 and their tests now span about 9.9k lines and 3.0k fixture lines with heavy overlap, which slows every change. The same landing reviews left follow-ups: proving no report text leaks into the built site, three result-handling decisions, ADR-0055 notes (#166), and a hard-coded English 'Overview' sidebar label (#161).
purpose_tldr: Cut the Gherkin and scenario-results test suite by at least 30% without losing a guard, close the scenario-results follow-ups, and make the sidebar's Overview label translatable.
